title: Pin escape-hatch policy and compatibility bundle negotiator
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Customers pin model versions for stability. When a pinned model becomes deprecated, fails compatibility checks, or an entire region loses capacity, we currently have ad-hoc fallbacks which either (a) silently swap variants and risk quality regressions or (b) block traffic and require manual ops intervention. This ticket defines a deterministic, observable 'escape-hatch' policy and a runtime 'compatibility bundle negotiator' that orchestrates safe substitutions for pinned versions across regions and variants with explicit deprecation flows and telemetry-backed safety gates.
background_and_goals: Provide a single policy and runtime behavior for handling pinned-version unavailability or deprecation
Avoid silent quality regressions by requiring compatibility scoring and regression probes before substituting a variant
Expose clear notices and grace windows to customers when their pinned version is entering deprecation
Enable automated regional substitution when capacity/regional outage is detected, and ensure rollback escape-hatch if SLA or quality degrades
Keep operational complexity low: prefer runtime-driven decisions with policy overrides rather than manual triage
design_decisions: Introduce 'compatibility bundles' — curated sets of candidate variants (primary, near-match, cost-saver) with precomputed capability vectors and fallback weights

Implement a lightweight 'negotiator' service in the control plane that evaluates candidates against runtime capability (kernels/quantization support), region affinity, and quality probes before routing
Fallback gating uses three signals: capability compatibility score, live quality probe pass rate (>= 95%), and latency SLO headroom (> 20% spare)

Deprecation flow publishes notices to Console + API (pinned_version.deprecation_notice), and sets a configurable grace_window (default 30 days) during which automatic substitution is allowed only in 'soft' mode (traffic mirrored + limited percentage)
Escape-hatch: a circuit-breaker per-pin that immediately rolls traffic to 'grace' target (customer-configurable) on severe regressions; requires explicit audit log and customer notification
acceptance_criteria: Customers can opt into compatibility bundles at onboarding and view the candidate list in Console
Negotator can evaluate candidates and return a ranked substitution plan with reasons within 50ms median decision time
Automated substitution only occurs when compatibility score >= 0.85 AND probe pass-rate >= 95% AND latency headroom > 20%
Deprecation notice lifecycle appears in Console and API for pinned versions and includes grace_window and recommended bundle
Circuit-breaker escape-hatch triggers when quality probes fall below 90% for 2 consecutive minutes and can be audited in the event log
End-to-end e2e test coverage for: regional outage substitution, deprecation ramp, and escape-hatch rollback
implementation_steps: Schema: extend model_catalog entries with compatibility_vector, bundle_candidates, and deprecation metadata
Control plane: add negotiator endpoint that accepts (pin_key, region, runtime_capabilities) and returns substitution_plan
Runtime: accept substitution_plan with warmup tokens parameter and pre-warm KV cache on candidate endpoints
Telemetry: add probe jobs (synthetic prompt set per-customer pin) and surface pass-rate/quality drift in Console
Console/API: display bundles, deprecation notices, and allow customers to configure grace_window and escape-hatch target
Rollout: feature-flagged rollout with canary on internal orgs -> trusted customers -> general availability
progress_updates: 2025-11-12 — RFC posted to design-docs: outlined compatibility bundle concept and safety gates; initial feedback requests from SRE and Product
2025-11-14 — SRE: requested explicit latency headroom metric and defend against thundering herd during substitution; added warmup token requirement
2025-11-16 — Product: requested customer-facing wording for deprecation notices and an opt-out 'manual-only' mode; added Console acceptance criteria
2025-11-18 — Engineering: implemented model_catalog schema extension and negotiator proto; basic evaluator returns ranked candidates locally
2025-11-20 — QA: started e2e tests for probe jobs and simulated regional outage substitution in staging; found race condition in warmup path (next step: patch)
2025-11-20 — Decision: use probe pass-rate threshold 95% and fallback score threshold 0.85 after cross-team calibration
open_questions: What is the canonical customer-visible compatibility score explanation? (product writing needed)
Should we allow automatic substitution to lower-cost variants during high-cost events? (billing implications)
What default bundle sizes are reasonable per-model family (1-3 candidates)?
Operational: who gets paged on repeated escape-hatch activations? (runbooks needed)
risks_and_mitigation: Silent quality regressions: mitigate with mandatory probe pass-rate and mirror traffic during soft mode
Thundering warmup: mitigate with warmup token rate limits and staggered pre-warm scheduling
Customer surprise: mitigate via console notices, API deprecation fields, and email alerts for high-impact pins
Data leakage between variants: enforce tenant isolation and verify KV cache partitioning during substitution
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal dogfood + SRE chaos tests. Phase 2: invite-only customers (opt-in). Phase 3: default-on for new pins; opt-out for existing pins after 30-day communication. Post-launch: monitor probe pass-rate, escape-hatch activations, and customer support tickets for 90 days.
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: probe_pass_rate < 90% for 2 minutes -> page on-call and trigger circuit-breaker
Alert: escape-hatch count > 3 in 24h for same customer -> customer success outreach
notes_for_release: Add release notes describing deprecation notices and default 30-day grace window. Document how to opt-out and the meaning of compatibility score. Include migration guide for customers with strict pinning policies.
qa_checklist: Simulate regional outage and validate negotiator substitutes within 1 minute
Validate that mirror mode sends <= 5% of traffic to candidate until probe pass-rate stable
Verify audit log entries for every substitution and escape-hatch activation
Run long-tail latency regression test with warmup tokens enabled
